title: Add PATCH /todos/{id} to toggle done
description: Add a PATCH endpoint in app/main.py that flips the todo's `done` flag and returns the todo (404 if missing). Add a test in tests/test_todos.py. Run pytest -q.

title: Reject empty todo titles on POST /todos
description: POST /todos with a blank or whitespace-only title must return 422. Validate in the TodoIn model in app/main.py. Add a test in tests/test_todos.py. Run pytest -q.

title: Write tests for GET /health
description: Add tests/test_health.py covering status code and body of GET /health. Touches tests/ only. Run pytest -q.
